newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Ventspils 1996 oil reloadings up 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Ventspils 1996 oil reloadings up 28 pct.

text.p: Latvia's Ventspils oil terminal, one of the main outlets for Russian crude and oil products, said on Thursday that its reloadings in 1996 were up 28 percent.
Ventspils Nafta reloaded 25.3 million tonnes of crude oil and oil products in 1996 versus 19.9 million tonnes in 1995, a company spokesman told Reuters.

Loadings of crude oil rose to 14.3 million tonnes (around 286,000 barrels per day) in 1996 from 12 million tonnes (240,000 bpd) in 1995 while loadings of diesel rose to 9.3 million tonnes from 6.7 million tonnes.
The company said that 296,300 tonnes of petrol were reloaded but did not give comparative figures.
The port company is currently state-owned but is on the privatisation list with the process expected to be completed during 1997-98.
